mainEntity.name: What utility connections are needed for a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home typically requires connections for water, electricity, and sewage. For water, this can be a standard city hookup, a well system, or a rainwater harvesting system. Electricity can come from grid connection, solar panels, or a combination (hybrid system). Sewage options include connection to a municipal sewer, a septic tank, or composting toilets for off-grid living. We design utility systems to match your property's existing infrastructure and your desire for on-grid or off-grid living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes need connections for water, electricity, and sewage. Options include city hookups, wells, solar, septic, or composting, depending on your property and lifestyle.
